STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_035036.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_035036.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_035036 (
    input wire        CLK,
    RST,
    Enable,
    input wire [ 7:0] Ex_ext,
    Ey_ext,
    input wire [22:0] Mx_ext,
    My_ext,

    output wire [23:0] Mx_conc,
    My_conc,
    output reg  [ 9:0] Ez_add
);

  //internal signals
  wire one_op_den;

  wire zero_Ex, zero_Ey;
  wire Conc_X, Conc_Y;

  //Flip_Flops 
  reg [7:0] Ex, Ey;
  reg [22:0] Mx, My;


  assign zero_Ex = ~|Ex;
  assign zero_Ey = ~|Ey;

  assign Conc_X = ~zero_Ex;
  assign Conc_Y = ~zero_Ey;

  assign Mx_conc = {Conc_X, Mx};
  assign My_conc = {Conc_Y, My};



  assign one_op_den = zero_Ex ^ zero_Ey;


  always @(posedge CLK or negedge RST) begin
    if (!RST) begin
      ////////inputs RST
      Ex <= 0;
      Ey <= 0;
      Mx <= 0;
      My <= 0;
    end else if (!Enable) begin
      ////////inputs Reg
      Ex <= Ex_ext;
      Ey <= Ey_ext;
      Mx <= Mx_ext;
      My <= My_ext;
    end
  end


  always @(*) begin
    Ez_add = Ex + Ey + 10'b1110000001 + one_op_den;  // -10'b127
  end


endmodule
